title: America's Book of Secrets
description:
S04 E06 — Inside Area 51
After decades of secrecy, denials and cover-ups, the CIA in 2013 declassify documents confirming the existence of secret military research facility Area 51.

title: Quest for the Lost Ark
description: Professor Tudor Parfitt embarks on a harrowing journey of discovery to reveal where the Ark of the Covenant may be found and what it may look like.

title: Bible Battles
description: Exploring the biblical world from a military perspective.

title: The Dark Ages
description: Charlemagne, St. Benedict and the Empress Theodora help to bridge the gap of civilization between Rome and the Renaissance.

title: History's Crazy Rich Ancients
description:
S01 E09 — Power Couples
The average American couple will drop five figures on their wedding, but that wouldn't even begin to cover the tab that these big spending couples racked up while throwing history's most baller nuptial celebrations.

title: Vietnam in HD
description:
S01 E01 — The Beginning (1964-1965)
Operation Rolling Thunder roars across the skies over North Vietnam; American soldiers are outnumbered in the Ia Drang Valley.

title: Vietnam in HD
description:
S01 E02 — Search & Destroy (1966-1967)
American troops launch widespread search and destroy operations; body count becomes the measure of success in Vietnam; Charles Brown fights for survival on the bloody slopes of Hill 875 and at home; the American public begins to question strategy.

title: Vietnam in HD
description:
S01 E03 — The Tet Offensive (1968)
The massive Tet Offensive catches the Americans by surprise; U.S. troops are under siege at Khe Sanh and Pleiku; Americans mount a counteroffensive, but the shock of the assault ignites anti-war fervor at home.

title: Vietnam in HD
description:
S01 E04 — An Endless War (1968-1969)
The turmoil of 1968 helps Nixon win the presidency; the draft accelerates; Karl Marlantes endures bitter jungle fighting on Hill 484; Arthur Wiknik gets a grim introduction to combat.

title: Vietnam in HD
description:
S01 E05 — A Changing War (1969-1970)
Troop withdrawals begin; Gery Benedetti patrols the Mekong Delta; James Anderson leads a battalion into Cambodia; Don DeVore struggles to survive a fierce night attack; Anne Purcell gets promising news about her husband.

title: Vietnam in HD
description:
S01 E06 — Peace With Honor (1971-1975)
Bob Clewell's helicopter crew comes under intense fire; Joe Galloway returns to Vietnam; Barry Romo throws down his medals in protest; Anne Purcell awaits word of her husband's fate; the unification of Vietnam.

title: Lost Worlds
description:
S02 E16 — Ivan the Terrible's Fortresses
Ivan the Terrible, Russia's first czar, originates the secret police, is a ruthless military leader, destroys great cities and builds new fortresses as he expands the borders of his realm.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S01 E03 — Viking Battle Axe
The bladesmiths have to turn a steel train spring into a weapon of their choosing; only two competitors will move on and are given only five days to forge a legendary Viking Battle Axe.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S01 E04 — Katar
Competitors make their signature blade by using the Hada technique, a traditional process that involves forging multiple layers of steel together.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S01 E02 — Chakram
The finalists go to their home forges to create an ancient Indian Chakram, and they return with two very different interpretations of that deadly, circular throwing weapon; only one stands up to the judges' dynamic battery of tests.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S07 E11 — The Barbarian Spatha
Four smiths must salvage steel from old weapons and combine them using the hada technique to forge a pugio; only two smiths march down the Appian Way to their home forges to re-create one of the most vicious swords in Roman history.

title: Forged in Fire: Beat the Judges
description:
S01 E01 — Short Sword Damascus
Three champions return to the forge, hoping to defeat one of the three judges; after forging signature blades and a Khanda, one champion survives to enter their toughest challenge yet, competing against a judge.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S01 E01 — Japanese Katana
Bladesmiths have to forge one of the most iconic weapons from history, the Japanese Katana; their swords will be pushed to the absolute limit with the final test determining which is stronger.

title: Top Shot
description:
S01 E01 — The Long Shot
Using unfamiliar rifles/weapons of different eras, 16 sharpshooters compete in an obstacle course; two participants compete in a long-distance sniper challenge, with the loser to go home.

title: Top Shot
description:
S01 E03 — Archer Enemies
Contestants compete with longbows; a team wins immunity; two competitors face off in a William Tell elimination challenge.

title: Top Shot
description:
S01 E04 — Friend or Foe?
The remaining 13 contestants' ability to tell a friend from a foe is tested; rising tension threatens the strength of the teams.

title: Top Shot
description:
S01 E02 — Zipline of Fire
The slide-action Beretta puts the contestants' pistol skills to the test; team accuracy is ranked; two compete in a zip-line elimination challenge.

title: Top Shot
description:
S01 E06 — Wild, Wild West
Targets fly in an extreme shooting gallery; halfway through the competition a rule change forces contestants to start evaluating their own teammates.

title: Top Shot
description:
S01 E07 — Trick Shot Showdown
The contestants face off at legendary trick shots including shooting backwards with a mirror, hammering nails into a board with bullets and throwing multiple targets in the air to shoot.

title: Top Shot
description:
S01 E05 — The Good, The Rat and The Ugly
Using muzzle-loading weapons, contestants compete in an old-fashioned frontier face-off; a heated conflict on one team plays out in the elimination challenge.
